opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Mont. Certio-rari granted. Brief of petitioner is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, January 19, 1996. Brief of respondent is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, February 16, 1996. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
